rules.title: P.L. 2025, c.405 (Residential rental property application fee not to exceed $50)
rules.requirement: A landlord or agent may not require an application or similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property that exceeds $50. The cap is adjusted annually by CPI change; any amount wrongfully charged is remitted to the applicant from the collected penalty.
rules.key_value: $50 cap, adjusted annually for CPI (NY-Northern NJ-Long Island area) when the change is above zero
rules.penalty: Up to $500 first offense, up to $750 second offense, up to $1,000 each subsequent offense; wrongfully charged amount remitted to applicant
rules.status_basis: Approved January 20, 2026; takes effect on the first day of the fourth month next following enactment (May 1, 2026).

exempt_if.text: a dwelling unit located in a one-family or two-family dwelling that is offered for rent

exempt_if.name: real_estate_licensee
exempt_if.text: a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission, unless the licensee is the landlord of the residential rental property

coverage.summary: Applies to landlords and their agents charging application fees for residential rentals.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts units in one- or two-family dwellings and NJ Real Estate Commission licensees who are not the landlord.

rules.quoted_span: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
